newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates fall on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates fall on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistani money rates slid to 3.50 percent at the close after opening at 15 percent on Tuesday after an inflow of 1.5 billion rupees from a maturing open market operation (OMO), dealers said.
A dealer at Standard Chartered Bank in Karachi said rates were likely to rise on Wednesday due to the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's regular weekly OMO.
He said the central bank had received the bids of 12.452 billion rupees in its latest short-term federal bonds auction, whose result is to be announced on Wednesday.
